description: Records the person's own answer to the AI-sharing question after a creation tool returned ai_processing_choice_required. allowed true means Allow and false means Not now. Consent counts only as that explicit reply; it is never inferred from the request to create and never supplied on the person's behalf. supersedes is the sequence that refusal returned (null when it was unset). Returns the stored answer; nothing is created or charged.

allowed.description: The person's explicit answer: true for Allow, false for Not now.

supersedes.description: The sequence from the ai_processing_choice_required refusal; null when it was unset.

name: studio_ai_sharing_choose
title: Record the AI-sharing answer
